coursework.summary: Follow actual course and assignment instructions; instructor examples and scoped Feinberg conditions are not universal student permission.

exams.summary: Exam aids without authorization are prohibited; these reviewed materials establish no uniform AI default for every exam.

ai_disclosure.summary: Submitted work requires proper attribution and authorization; disclosure format depends on course requirements, not a universal prompt-log checklist.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Data-use validation, provider permission and named school/clinical controls apply; scopes differ by school and setting.

academic_integrity.summary: Unauthorized authorship can be cheating or plagiarism; Part C process and appeals apply only to listed schools, and TGS stages remain distinct.

approved_tools.summary: Copilot Chat and some school-funded products have scoped access; SSO catalog roles and exact product prices remain unverified.

named_ai_services.summary: Named ChatGPT/Claude access is school-funded and eligibility-specific; no universal student access or price is established.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructor-facing Open/Conditional/Closed examples and dated Provost communications are recommendations, not universal rules.

research_guidance.summary: Panopto is restricted for non-public interview data in the cited guidance; other research recording and publication conditions need separate checks.

security_procurement.summary: Protected-data grading and school workspaces have additional controls; a catalog listing or no-training statement is not procurement approval.
